notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness
At least one opponent has an even life total
You have an odd life total
easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down, then doubled.
Each player who started with an even life ottal loses the game for having 0 or less life.
